final: WITH t AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Accounts a JOIN Financial_Transactions f ON f.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city) SELECT account_id, town, n AS transaction_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS share_of_town, n * 1.0 / AVG(n) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
